turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to change the name on my flight reservation. I want to update it from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia.

I can help you with that. To proceed, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for the booking you want to update. If you don’t know your reservation ID, please provide your user ID and I can help locate it. Could you please provide your user ID?

Thank you for providing your user ID. You have several reservations. Could you please provide the reservation ID for the booking where you want to update the passenger name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia? If you’re not sure which reservation it is, let me know and I can help you identify it.
The reservation ID is 3RK2T9. I just need the name changed from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia on that booking.

To confirm, you want to update the passenger name in reservation 3RK2T9 from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia, keeping the date of birth the same (1989-12-13). 

Please confirm that you would like to proceed with this name change.
Yes, please proceed with changing the name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia.

The name on your reservation 3RK2T9 has been updated from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. All other details remain the same.

If you need any further assistance with your reservation, please let me know!
Thank you for your help. That’s all I needed. ###STOP###
